Officer's narrative
On arrival in Baytown, Texas, I found a low-speed head-on collision between two passenger vehicles. Driver 1 was
seated behind the wheel of the first vehicle and reported pain in the left knee. Driver 2 stated that the vehicles came
together nose to nose at low speed, and that account matched what the statements from independent witnesses at
the scene described. A Passenger was also in Driver 1's vehicle, and both the Passenger and Driver 1 were seen
there by responding units. Damage to both front ends was consistent with the direction and focre of impact described,
and photographs taken at the scene show no prior body or frame damage on Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 presented an
insurance card listing Driver 1 as the named insured on the policy. Driver 1 was transported for evaluation of the knee
injury, which I consider consistent with the mechanism of the collision. No citations were issued at the scene.
</page>
